palette.$description: Generated by scripts/GeneratePalette.mjs: do not edit. envUI’s primitive palette. Each grade is a band of WCAG 2 relative luminance shared by every hue, so a difference of 40 grades gives at least 3:1, 50 at least 4.5:1 and 70 at least 7:1. Internal: only the semantic tokens alias it.

neutral.$description: The slightly blue-tinted gray of text, borders and surfaces in both themes, seeded from the light divider, the muted text and the dark pane, so dark surfaces keep less chroma, as dark grays read bluer.

blue.$description: The brand blue: primary actions, links, selection and focus. Seeded from the light selection tint, the dark theme’s soft blue and the primary blue.

slate.$description: The low-chroma blue-gray of quiet tints: the dark theme’s selection and the light theme’s navigation hover. Seeded from 0.7’s light navigation hover and press and its dark selected option.

steel.$description: The quieter blue of information, seeded from the info toast.

teal.$description: The teal green of success toasts, seeded from 0.7’s.

purple.$description: The accent purple of important actions.
